scope_change_reason: The current independent-moment card's #2979 scope does not cover the user's assigned idle-axis research. PR3220 explicitly leaves cross-group shared repairs open. This bounded follow-up changes the object to the source-pinned rank-two defect and the method to exact direct-sum rank plus an optional OR-Tools rank-packing optimum; it does not audit or claim a full supplier.
bottleneck_link: A shared correction can reverse the idle-axis no-go only if sharing lowers its charged rank cost below the per-group moment allowance. For independent groups the source defect ranks add, forcing at least two repair-rank units per group even under globally shared packaging.

Stop without generalizing to overlapping real T740 groups, absorbed repairs or changed interactions.
